enVoy is the AI communication system enterprises give to their customers — WhatsApp, email, web chat, app and voice, connected to the CRM. A weYou X product.

# enVoy


## What enVoy is

enVoy is not a single chatbot. It is the whole customer-communication lifecycle on one system: it captures every enquiry, understands the customer from the first message, replies in your voice, checks live availability, books across team calendars, follows up, and writes structured details back to your CRM.

## Key facts

- Channels: WhatsApp, Email, Chatbot, App, Voice
- Languages: Any written language — Kannada, Hindi and English out of the box.
- Go-live: 7 days from signup
- Connects to your records, inventory and team calendars; writes every customer's details back to the CRM
- Industries: medical care, schools & colleges, spas & wellness, real estate, resorts & hotels, and other inbound businesses
- Contact: sales@weyoux.com
- Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

## Part of weYou X

Part of weYou X (https://weyoux.com). Sister wings: weYou World (https://weyouworld.com/) - web, app and design; LegalIndia.ai (https://legalindia.ai/) - legal AI.
